description: This file defines an Orleans grain interface for testing stateless worker scaling behavior, including methods for waiting, releasing, and getting activation and waiting counts.

classes.name: IStatelessWorkerScalingGrain
classes.description: Interface for a stateless worker scaling grain with methods to monitor and control its state.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Asynchronously waits; implementation details depend on the concrete class.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases or resets the grain's state, decorated with AlwaysInterleave attribute for concurrency control.

methods.name: GetActivationCount
methods.description: Returns the number of activations for this grain, asynchronously.

methods.name: GetWaitingCount
methods.description: Returns the number of waiters or pending operations, asynchronously.
